description: Sorts the channels of up to ten polyphonic cables by voltage, and can hold several of them in the same order

params.text: Sorts this row on the order worked out for the row above instead of on its own voltages, so the two stay lined up channel for channel; the lamp is lit while it is on

outputs.text: The channels of the cable in the jack beside it, lowest voltage first, with the same number of channels as went in

notes: the top row has no link button, because there is no row above it to take an order from
a chain of linked rows all follow the topmost unlinked row above them, so a whole group can be kept in step
all ten rows are sorted in the same sample, so the outputs stay lined up with each other
the link buttons on rows 9 and 10 are not saved with the patch and come back off when it is loaded
